summary: The proposed patch addresses the functional incompleteness of handling all-NaN data in `ax.bar`, but introduces a potential behavioral regression risk.

issues.description: The current implementation still raises an exception when passing all-NaN data to `ax.bar`. The patch should handle this case gracefully.
Introducing a default value of `np.nan` in `_safe_first_finite` could potentially mask other issues where `np.nan` values are not handled correctly elsewhere in the codebase.
